description:
Use this when the user wants several Indian indices compared on return, volatility and drawdown over the same period.

Returns, for each index over the same window, the price return, annualised volatility, largest fall from a peak, and best and worst day, computed from NSE's daily closes. `indices` is a list of 2 to 10 NSE index names, such as ["Nifty 50", "Nifty Bank"]; a name that is not found is reported along with the valid names. The window is `days` back from the latest day held (default 365, at most 1825), or `from_date` and `to_date`. Returns exclude dividends. For one index's P/E and P/B use get_index_valuation.
name: compare_indices
title: Compare indices
